neighbours.label: the slot just before a named figure of myth or esoteric lore: ' of' in 'son of Odin', ' by' in 'translated by Dr. Doreal'. The pole expects a mythic or legendary name; the same 'son of' before an ordinary person stays quiet, and so does myth with no name coming
